name: Felsworn: Sargeron Smite generates 20 Energy on hit (#5165)
contract: Sargeron Smite 501314 (rank 1 of 802060, Felsworn level 10) reads 'generates 20 Energy'. No spell_proc row, no script energize, no native ENERGIZE effect wires it: OnSpellHitResult only generates Felfury on self-hits (effect 175 -> 800058) and 1 Felfury via Bane, while Energy grants elsewhere are explicit EnergizeBySpell calls (Outland Slaver 705123 +3, channel refund 800355). The fix grants 20 Energy on a successful hostile hit through the same EnergizeBySpell path. The discriminator is power-3 gain over the cast cost, mirroring the Templar Tyr-energy window shape.
